name: The Bones of St. Andral
summary: Someone has stolen the bones of St. Andral from the crypt of Vallaki's church, and with them the only thing that kept the dead out of it.

stages.journal: Vallaki says Father Lucian has stripped the altar at St. Andral's and won't say why, and that Milivoj the gravedigger has been spending more than he earns. Something has gone from the church that shouldn't have.
objectives: Ask Father Lucian at St. Andral's what has happened
stages.hint: Talk to Father Lucian at St. Andral's Church in Vallaki.

stages.journal: Father Lucian of St. Andral's told us the saint's bones have been stolen from the crypt beneath his altar. While they lay there, the dead could not set foot in the church. Without them, he fears for his flock and for anyone sheltering under his roof.
objectives: Find out who took the bones
Bring them back to the crypt
stages.hint: Find Milivoj the gravedigger in Vallaki's lower town by day; he has been spending more than he earns.

stages.journal: Milivoj the gravedigger admitted he dug up the bones and sold them to Henrik van der Voort, the coffin maker, for enough coin to feed his brothers and sister through the winter.
stages.hint: Visit Henrik van der Voort at the coffin maker's shop in Vallaki and ask about the bones.

stages.journal: Henrik confessed: he bought the bones because something told him to. That something sleeps in crates in his storeroom, and it is waiting for a night when the church is undefended.
objectives: Search the coffin maker's storeroom by day
Or keep vigil at St. Andral's after dark
stages.hint: Search the storeroom at the back of the coffin maker's shop by day, ready for a fight. Or keep vigil with Father Lucian at St. Andral's after dark.

stages.journal: We held St. Andral's through a night of the undead. The church still stands, but its crypt is still empty.
objectives: Recover the bones from the coffin maker's storeroom
stages.hint: The bones are still in the coffin maker's storeroom. Go in by day, ready for a fight.

stages.journal: The things in Henrik's storeroom were vampire spawn, and they are destroyed. The saint's bones are somewhere among the crates.
objectives: Take the bones back to Father Lucian
stages.hint: Take the bones back to Father Lucian at St. Andral's Church.

stages.journal: St. Andral's bones are back in their crypt and Father Lucian has blessed them again. The church is holy ground once more.
